attempts.query: SEKA ExAero GR M46J T1100 true one piece carbon
attempts.note: SEKA identifies Toray T1100G and M46J carbon with true one-piece molding, a continuous load path and no joined or bonded frame sections.

notes: Disposition: supported. Current exact GR page confirms Toray M46J and T1100 carbon and one-piece monocoque structure; no ply schedule is published. This is distinct from road ExAero. Reopen trigger: Reopen if SEKA changes the GR material specification.
